paidOutFormula: revenue 869,220,584 − operating cash flow 239,341,121 + capex 130,835,027 + interest paid in financing 31,082,117 (MXN thousands, as stated)
notes: IFRS filer that classifies interest paid in financing, so it is added back (31,082,117); income taxes paid are in operating. Lease payments (45,285,610, "Payment of liability related to right-of-use of assets") are in financing. Interest expense on lease liabilities was 16,594,964 in 2024 (lease note), but the 20-F does not say whether the cash paid for it sits in "Interest paid" or in the right-of-use payment line, so nothing more is added; if it is in the latter, paidOut is understated by up to about 2%. Interest received (3,489,600) sits in operating; dividends received are in investing. Acquisition of business was a net inflow in 2024 and is excluded. The USD column in the 20-F is a convenience translation and is not used; FX: calendar-2024 average.
